results.title: How to interpret PostgreSQL EXPLAIN ANALYZE output
results.snippet: Read the plan from the innermost node outwards. cost=0.00..35.50 is the estimated startup and total cost, rows is the estimated row count, and actual time= is what the executor really spent.

results.title: PostgreSQL: Documentation: EXPLAIN
results.snippet: EXPLAIN displays the execution plan the planner generates for a statement. With ANALYZE the statement is actually executed and real run times are shown alongside the estimates.

results.title: Explaining EXPLAIN: a guide to Postgres query plans
results.snippet: A plan is a tree of nodes. Each node reports the rows it expected and the rows it returned; a large gap between the two is usually where a slow query goes wrong.
